ios.desc:
Footage: Travel Video Camera - the Ultimate Travel Camera & Collaborative Private Video Journal.
Stop recording random clips. Start capturing the story.

Do you have thousands of travel videos and family clips buried in your camera roll that you never look at? Most of us do. 
The effort of gathering clips, using editing software, and trying to create a montage "later" is a chore that never gets done.

Footage changes everything. It is a revolutionary video camera app that turns your raw clips into narrated, organized, and cinematic stories. 
Designed specifically for travelers, families, and creators, Footage is the "story-first" camera that eliminates the need for post-production.

THE TRAVEL CAMERA REDEFINED
- Story-First Capture: Create a "Summer in Italy" project and record directly into it. Your movie builds itself in real-time.
- No More Editing: Say goodbye to spending hours in video editors. Footage organizes your scenes chronologically and logically as you film.
- Narrative Flow: Capture the atmosphere, the sounds, and the story of your trip with a camera designed for storytelling.

COLLABORATIVE VACATION MOVIES
- Shared Stories: Invite friends or family to see your story via a simple link.
- Group Contribution: Everyone in the group can contribute their own clips to the same movie. No more "AirDropping".
- Instant Sync: When a friend adds a clip from their iPhone, it appears in your shared story instantly.
- Live Updates: Family back home can follow your journey in real-time as new "scenes" are added to the shared film.

PRIVACY & iCLOUD INTEGRATION
- Your iCloud, Your Rules: All video footage is safely backed up and synced using your personal iCloud account.
- 100% Private: No third-party servers. No data harvesting. Your videos belong to you and the people you choose to share them with.
- No Registration: No email sign-ups, no passwords. Just open the app and start filming.
- Full Resolution: Enjoy 4K quality with no quality loss, unlike messaging apps or social media platforms.

POWERFUL IN-APP TOOLS
- Inline Editing: Effortlessly crop, reorder, or move clips between stories with a few taps.
- Quick Launch: Use Lock Screen widgets to launch the Footage camera in a split second - never miss a spontaneous moment again.
- Multi-Device Support: Start your story on your iPhone, edit the sequence on your iPad, and watch the final result on your Mac.
